reviews.title: Rude staff, bad customer services
reviews.text: They have the worst customer services ever, they dont know how to assist customers, horrible work ethics and they just cant be bothered with you. It is best you purchase from a reputable company who knows how to treat their customers with respect and not discard you once they have your money. Stay away from this crowd!
reviews.author: JBMWilson

reviews.title: Useless Airline ever, dont waste your money
reviews.text: Customer services team suck real bad, only want your money and dont want to help you afterwards. Tried to discuss re: customers who were caught pre-covid19 last year March 2020, they dont care, they only force customers to pay the difference of fares every year while their Govt canx flights, a real ripoff. Stay away from this useless outfit, go to a reputable company who knows how to listen and not give you a "rinse and repeat" crap on their email replies.
reviews.author: Jo M

reviews.title: The Worst Business Class Experience Ever
reviews.text: We Were travelling away for our Wedding Anniversary and we decided to upgrade to Business Class at the Airport. What a huge mistake. Paid $400 for each upgrade and when we got onto the plane our seats did not recline, so we brought this to the attention of the flight attendant, who just smiled and went about doing nothing. We eventually changed seats and they did not work much better. When our meal arrived it was below expectations. The best way to describe it was roast grissel with gravy and vegetables, uneatable. We were served soft drink and were offered no other beverage for the duration of the flight. The staff were not interested in treating us in the way that is expected when you purchase a business class ticket. It must be noted that it was a MALINDO air and cabin crew. This was a wasted investment and I would not recommend flying this airline ever if considering overseas flights.
reviews.author: Wayne H

reviews.title: Good Service overall
reviews.text: Samoan airways is small international airline operated by the Samoan government. Currently Malindo airline is operating all their international routes. The cabin crew were very helpful and friendly. The food was good. Each seat has an onboard entertainment. I'd recommend bringing your own headphones or you purchase earphones for $5 (Tala or Aus/NZ dollars) Overall it was a pretty good experience.
reviews.author: Ronald N

reviews.title: Worse than bad
reviews.text: Having flown on 50 or more airlines I have flown with some pretty dodgy carriers, our sad tale started when we were supposed to travel fro SYD to APW on Thursday 23rd 2020, this flight was inexplicably canceled and we e=were bumped to a flight a whole week earlier OL2850 Friday 17th. When on-line to check into this flight and choose our seats I discover I had been bumped from this flight to an evening flight OL856, without my knowledge of advice. This made what was supposed to be a holiday in Samoa to celebrate a over the Australia Day weekend to a short break. I had accommodation booked for the night of the 17th, but this was obviously useless as OL856 is an overnight flight. A day lost due to Samoan Airlines sketchy schedule. The flight OL656 at 2055 was an hour late departing, and there were only around 35 people on the flight, which was nice for those of us that liked to stretch out. The meal service: OK as there was no problem getting my choice of meal, but it was stone cold, pressing the call button to try and have it changed was an exercise as it went unanswered, I complained when the meal service was cleaned up and got a shoulder shrug for my efforts. During the flight of over six hours I tried in vain to get the attention of cabin crew for a drink to no avail, after the meal service the crew were not sighted until preparation for landing. Quite possibly the worst airline service I have ever received. OL855 from APW to SYD was almost as dire, a full service and although I was seated in row 10 my choice of meal was unavailable and the alternative "vegetarian meal" was inedible. Once again, after the meal service was cleared away the cabin crew were invisible. Being charged $5 for ear buds and $10 for drinks is an outrage for a full service airline. Even though I will visit Samoa again I will try my best not to fly with Samoan Airlines.
reviews.author: griz943

reviews.title: Ok flight  food terrible
reviews.text: Good leg room .horrible food .my wife was told she could not have a blanket because they only give them to children
reviews.author: Allan P

reviews.title: The best onboard atmosphere in a long time
reviews.text: It was operated by a Polynesian airline so the pilots and the staff were not Samoan. However, the ground staff and some of the onboard staff were Samoan. In addition, a whole Samoan air crew were on board after training with this airline. And what a fabulous atmosphere onboard. Laughter, friendliness, good food, lots of banter. I thoroughly enjoyed my flight.
reviews.author: Martin d

reviews.title: First timer
reviews.text: I always fly with Air New Zealand so this was a first for me, our flight was delayed (nothing new) it was a different aircraft. As this was a late night flight Syd-Apia, the economy section towards the front 10 rows all had to sit in a non air con space throughout the flight which was very uncomfortable apart from requesting multiple times. My brother in law upgraded to Business Class so that my nephew his wife and 1 year old could sit together as they had advised the flight was full, upon departing I noticed that all the rows on the flight had a vacant seat between them.Which lead me to think (What a way to get sales up! dont think I would fly with them again!
reviews.author: Resitara A

reviews.title: Slow service
reviews.text: The only thing wrong with the flight was the food and drink service. On the outward flight leaving at nearly 10pm, the meal wasn’t served until three hours into the flight when most people were sleeping. On the return late afternoon journey, it was a similar story but in addition there were no vegetarian meals on board and no offer of wine so I said I’d just have the bread roll and waited a further 40 minutes!
reviews.author: Ann R

reviews.title: Stolen items from locked suitcase
reviews.text: Last week, I flew with Samoa Airways. I checked in Apia and flew to New Zealand. I packed everything in my suitcase and locked it. I checked in 2 hours before my flight. When I arrived to Auckland, I picked up my suitcase, it was still locked. Later when I opened it, I saw that all my jewelry and make up was missing. I contacted Samoa Airways and airport and never heard back from them. Now I understand whay wrapping line was 10x longer than check in line. They have criminals working and getting rich of stealing other people's stuff.
reviews.author: Aida

reviews.title: Surprisingly pleasant flights
reviews.text: Had no idea what to expect as i had read mixed reviews, on arrival we were checked in quite quickly. As I have mobility issues Dominic from the airline quickly offered wheelchair assistance in Sydney and on arrival in Samoa. All went smoothly with the flight, crew were lovely and there was actually leg room on the plane for a change. I would fly with the Again
reviews.author: Dinkydi2001

reviews.title: Fly with samoa airways!
reviews.text: So I actually flew them in October 2018 and they are amazing af. On board a 4 hour flight, there's no touchscreen but its really nice and the crew are like their own people. So I was with my dad and a woman at the end. We were complaining for 2 minutes and then the flight attendent just moved her to an empty seat. Recommended to people flying to Samoa🇼🇸
reviews.author: Konsicki

reviews.title: On a Wing and a Prayer.
reviews.text: Obviously not too many set rules. Check in 20 mins beforehand for an international flight. Everything pretty old school. No internet check-in, etc. Flying as it used to be!
reviews.author: petertaylor57

reviews.title: Comfortable, good leg room.
reviews.text: Good value. Friendly service, comfortable. I liked that the fare included bag and meal. Food was good.
reviews.author: Janice T

reviews.title: Very average airline.
reviews.text: Mixed feelings really. A half empty plane means you get to stretch out a bit but no pillows and blankets on an international flight and an older plane that the headrests don't bend to create a true headrest meant a pretty uncomfortable flight. Most airlines are in a hurry to dim the lights and let everyone who wants to sleep that opportunity, these guys liked the lights on as long as possible. A lot of inflight sets didn't appear to work as they were blank and you couldn't turn them off (for darkness). Inflight beverage option was poor and food was pretty sad. On the plus side it was direct Apia to Brisbane so no stopover in NZ was good. I love NZ but if you don't have time to enjoy the stop its just extra travel time. Inflight staff are really lazy, like REALLY lazy, I don't know why they are so bad as the Samoan people we met were awesome but most of staff don't appear to be Samoan. My flights were pretty smooth for checkin etc but I see the potential for disaster as other reviewers have indicated.
reviews.author: Neil M

reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: Return Flight to Apia from Auckland The service was ok Had 4 different attendants Ask if i needed an extension belt highly offensive i mean its ok to be asked but i get it im chunky dont get the whole airline to ask “if you dont own headphones make sure you take 5tala on plane to purchase some Its mellion aircraft seats are tiny but overall “Ok “ service I was happy with the food Sapasui with rice And happy to hear of vegetarian option Food was great
reviews.author: Bird_TeWini

reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.text: Whilst check-in procedure was a little out dated (no on line check in) the cost of the return flight to Apia represented great value compared to Air New Zealand without sacrificing service. Booking on line direct is the cheapest way as travel agents I believe do not get a discount and will charge you a booking fee (I have to thank the consultant I used at Flight Centre for this information-he saved me £50.00). I understand from other comments service can be variable, but I had no such issues. Thanks for a great flight.
reviews.author: allan o

reviews.title: Mixed feels
reviews.text: The plane was fantastic, clean the service and food were both great but...for some reason they seemed to want to keep us awake... lights did not dim for very long , dinner in early morning (11pm departure) around 1.30 - 2 ..in reality they should not have a meal maybe breakfast for a 5.15 flight it seemed longer most got off feeling shattered.. but the flight itself was very good... I would fly again with them
reviews.author: Karen H

reviews.title: Samoa Airlines flight
reviews.text: Both the departing flight from Brisbane & the return flight from Samoa were over an hour late in leaving. Unable to make up time on flight. On both flights the hot beverage service was suspended due to "air turbulence " soon after take off and never reinstated during the flight even though there was no turbulence and the fasten seat belt sign was not on. There were no blankets available on the flight over which was a night time flight which left Brisbane at 2350. There were no headphones available for the inflight entertainment. The cabin service was minimal at best.
reviews.author: terka8

reviews.title: The absolute worst customer service!
reviews.text: We missed booking 2 flights because customer service do not reply to emails or phone calls. Absolutely impossible to reach to redeem a voucher for cancelled flights. As soon as I mentioned I had a voucher the replies to emails stopped and phone calls rung out. We then got stuck at the service desk at the airport for 3 hours (with 2 very unhappy small children) because they didn't book the flights! Terrible, terrible, TERRIBLE! Hats to the airport staff who wear the blows from angry customers. They were amazing. The call centre staff need to take a leaf out of their books. Very disappointed Samoa Air. Absolutely useless.
reviews.author: Rebecca

reviews.title: Samoa Airway
reviews.text: Awesome customer services on the plane. Great experience. Enjoy the flight with my little family who also enjoyed their 1st plane ride to beautiful Samoa
reviews.author: Kui8

reviews.title: Good Service
reviews.text: Flew Samoan Airlines from Sydney found the ground staff and air crew friendly, did not have any problem with checking in, service in the air from the flight attendants was very good especially those male attendants oh what a sight, need more of them on other airlines., Great service from the crew .
reviews.author: jndawai

reviews.title: Comfortable and good service
reviews.text: It was a full flight and the crew got really strict on carry on baggage weight (1 piece only). There was also a delay for the flight to take off however the service is wonderful, they really feed you on this aircraft. Crew members always offering refills for drinks. Flights with Samoa airways are all in-clusive with meals and 23kgs check in baggage. You will need to use your own device to connect to their entertainment. So remember to take a power bank with you.
reviews.author: Cassandra Y

reviews.title: Extremely poor customer service
reviews.text: On the check-in we found out that the flight is going to be late. They told us around 4 hours due to the weather. That was a lie as eventually the flight was around 12 hours late and due to the plane being repaired in Fiji. During all that time of 12 hours, there was not a single update from Samoa Airline. Their representative was not on the airport. Calls to the New Zealand and Australian telephone numbers were going to the voicemail. There was no update at all at the airport’s public displays. The Auckland aiport information desks did not have any information. There was one local telephone at the airport which we found by chance, and upon callling somebody gave us an incorrect update. When called again it was going to voicemail. The only thing we received from Samoa was $15 voucher per person. For 12 hour delay, plus almost none of the food outlets was willing to accept them. The only bright side was Samoa Airline representative in Samoa who i called and she gave us correct update. However, no other contact from anybody else on the ground which i flind extremely poor. I will never attempt to fly Samoa Airline again.
reviews.author: jovanm27

reviews.title: Great Communication
reviews.text: We have been traveling with this company twice. The fist time it was from Apia to Pago Pago and return, with a really small aircraft. It has been an awesome experience for us because it was really easy to get and keep in touch with the company to book and buy all the tickets. It wasn't the first time for us flying with a small aircraft. This one was really old and noisy but the pilot did an amazing job so we could just keep taking pictures form above of both the countries. The second time was the return flight to Auckland and everything was fine. Their company has an Italian branded aircraft with Italians pilots. We enjoyed the flight and they have a really good customer service and they know how to take care of all the passengers. As i said it has been a nice experience but probably I wouldn't do it again since I don't like traveling with low cost companies.
reviews.author: ScarlettOtto

reviews.title: Samoa from above...
reviews.text: It was the first time that I traveled onA small aircraft that carried 17 passengers to American ?samoa and back. Not only that I learnt that all the passengers had to get weighed before they boarded the aero plane. The pilots were within a “touching distance”. I hestitated boarding the aeroplane seeing how much luggage some of the passengers were putting through the cargo. My hesitation was resolved once the pilots started the aircraft . The fight was quite pleasant except the noise. The returned flight was not as crowded and the noise from the aircraft was hardly noticeable. I took photos to show case Samoa from above. I am writ8ng this review on my experience traveling from Fagalii airport in a small air craft only...Therefore the boarding destination is not true, due a glitch in the system . They would not accept Fagalii airport as destination.
reviews.author: Ana C

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Our flight was delayed going from Sydney to Apia on jan 5 th ! The original flight was scheduled to leave at 9.25 Saturday and we didn't end up flying out till 2.30 pm then next day . We were stuck at Sydney airport for 17 hours ! When I finally arrived in Samoa I was then told my flight home will be 9 hours early My time in Samoa was cut short because of samoan airways I understand with the weather that these things can happen however it was how it was handled and the lack of communication at the airport that was disappointing For the cost of the flight there was also no entertainment screens on board ! And the food was very little and not good As someone who travels a lot with many different airlines I was very disappointed flying with Samoan airways I do not recommend them .
reviews.author: daniellekyneur

reviews.title: Communication despicable
reviews.text: I so wanted to give Samoa Airlines a good review but after my experience I will never ever fly Samoa Airlines again. Our flights were delayed due to bad weather in Sydney which is totally understandable (safety first) the issue that I had was the the contradictory information that was given by Samoa Airlines staff. We were we scheduled at least 6 times with each call/ email giving differing times it was so confusing and very stressful! You must check your emails and their facebook for updates otherwise you will b none-the-wiser. At one point we were advised 24 hours before the flight change so make sure that you either Roaming with your phone or purchase a sim card in Samoa. Communication was done via phone call and email. One occasion I received a phone call from one of the airline staff giving me a new departure time and in the email she sent that followed up the conversation (which I requested) gave a different departure time and date from what we just discussed! My suggestion would be to get everything in writing purely for insurance purposes should you need to claim anything back, I cannot stress this enough! To give you an example of the service let me share this a young staff member was disagreeing with my departure date when I had the date right in front of me she refused to believe my actual date of depature was right! She gave me a departure time a day earlier than my original and a separate flight from my family.. she was unapologetic and refused to believe she was wrong. Their excuse they are only human! My sis in law spoke to a staff member and asked to be compensated for accomadation and the c/c staff said wait... then she was heard speaking in samoan we dont do that aye? But aftermuch pushing and pressing Samoa Airways finally paid for a 1 nights accommodation and paid for an airport transfer. But that was after speaking to a manager she seemed more empathetic. I will say that the on-board service was lovely we flew business class and if you choose to risk it and fly with them I would suggest you fly business. There are 2 rows of 2 on either side,eight in total located at the front of the plane where you are served meals and drinks. The flight attendants were absolutely lovely. You are also able to take 64ks in total so two luggage bags with you and you get a premium check in which means you bypass all the lines which was a bonus. Overall, I am disappointed the call centre staff let the airline down with their contradictory information.The staff need more training- delays are inevitable i can deal with that, but incompetent staff really let Samoa Air down. For the safety of your holiday and deadlines I would suggest you fly a multiple carrier airline. All it takes is one delay on either side of the countries that they fly to and then you'll be truly stuffed its a gamble, fly at your own risk.
reviews.author: Michelle Peseta

reviews.title: Flight was smooth
reviews.text: As a developing airline they are doing the best they can 3 times I have flown with Samoa Airways I have not had any issues.
reviews.author: Hoo_Bruh

reviews.title: Return to Paradise
reviews.text: A first time flight for my 11 year old and ten years since I boarded a plane. Check in and flight staff helpful and friendly. Seating uncomfortably restrictive. Complimentary water luke warm. Lack of on-board entertainment options and reading material available to help pass the time. The complimentary meal was pretty basic with no dessert..
reviews.author: Naila Fanene

reviews.title: Good Economy airline with extras included
reviews.text: The airline is relatively new to Sydney and only flying Saturday and Thursday. Booking on line was very easy and very well priced compared to Virgin, Fiji and Air NZ. Samoa airlines flys direct to Apia and at 6 hours this is an easy flight for families with small children. Overnight flight out of Sydney was really pleasant the airport is not crowded at this time so no stress and less delays. Checking was easy enough, cabin luggage is weighed at checkin. The flight was comfortable the planes are not new or fancy, no individual screens or entertainment or usb charging points. There is inflight WiFi on your own device which was interesting enough but a usb charge point makes it easier to watch for 6 hours. Drinks were served quickly and the hot meals were plentiful and tasty. The crew were very pleasant throughout the flight. Seat suggestions are row 15 & 16 emergency exit row as they have a good amount of leg room. I would definitely fly Samoan Airlines again, budget priced but a bit of extras.
reviews.author: NICnBOO

reviews.title: Beware - confirmed/paid seats not guaranteed; tourists bumped to accommodate locals
reviews.text: This is a review of round trip flights between Apia Fagali Airport (FGI) and Pago Pago American Samoa (PPG). FGI was not found when we entered it above. We just were stranded in American Samoa overnight because the flights were overbooked, and the airline told us they prioritized Samoans over tourists. They seemed to be telling the truth, as we, along with another woman who lived in Australia, were removed from the flight to accommodate locals, resulting in us missing overseas flights. Beware if you have a “confirmed” seat/flight with them. A confirmed and paid ticket does NOT mean you are on the flight, especially if an employee’s family member or friend needs to be on the same flight. Confirm in advance at the airport and notate all communication in writing. Have the person you spoke to write down their name and contact information/title, as well as what you will be provided, as communication between the team in Apia Fagali (FGI) and Pago Pago (PPG) is virtually non-existent, with each team shifting blame to the other and telling stories inconsistent with what the other said. In a case like this where there is a competitor doing the same flight routes, I would highly recommend looking at the other company prior to considering this one. Samoan Airways seems to have more flight delays than its competitor who does the same flights to the same airports. If you are flying from Samoa to American Samoa as a tourist with other destinations planned, save yourself the headache and seek alternative options. This airline is best for locals. Note that we have been traveling in the South Pacific for a few weeks with many other flights with local airlines and have not had this issue. There was one case where we were bumped off our flight because of previous delayed flights resulting in overbooking, but once the staff knew we had international connections, they immediately helped to find a solution to get us out same day. We were also informed by our hotel staff upon arrival back in Samoa that when the daughter of one of the supervisors in Pago Pago told us to ask her father for help - he would and could help us - that in reality, they were looking for a bribe. We didn't know this and as such didn't offer one, and that seemed to have cut our chances of being added to the flight. If you happen to be stranded like us, consider this as an option, even though it seems illegal under US law.
reviews.author: Lovelylilac

reviews.title: Lovely flight
reviews.text: From booking to arrival and return flight - everything was hassle free. Loved that there were no long queues. Easy check in and very helpful staff. Flight left and landed on time. Friendly professional staff on board - very helpful. So lovely to hear the Samoan language being spoken by the staff to the passengers. Food and drinks was a lovely bonus. Great package deals flying with this airline. Thank you Samoa Air - I will not hesitate to fly with you again.
reviews.author: Rokro

reviews.title: Delays from Fagali'i to Pago Pago
reviews.text: Samoa Airlines was our only option to return from Upolu's tiny Fagali'i airport to Pago Pago (American Samoa). Our flight was delayed about 1.5 hours due to a mechanical issue earlier in the day that resulted in all flights being delayed afterwards. Luckily for us, it didn't impact our plans in American Samoa. Airline staff didn't do a very good job of informing passengers about the delay, nor offering any reconciliation. Once the plane finally did show up, crews worked incredibly quickly to load baggage and board passengers in a friendly way, and get the plane airborne. The tiny little twin otter plane provided a smooth, scenic flight across the International Date Line to American Samoa.
reviews.author: Keith-B-Robinson

reviews.title: Comfortable journey
reviews.text: I travelled both ways . Check in both the time was good. Comfortable seats and excellent staff always smiling. During the journey , vegetarian meal could not be offered as no supplies or finished but pleasenly , we were served freshly prepared tasty meal. I would suggest the airlines to have options for meal selection at the time of booking and should also take care to reply to the feedback.
reviews.author: Ravi S

reviews.title: Fun; Exciting; Great Views from Pago Pago (American Samoa) to Upolu (Samoa)
reviews.text: Flying with Samoa Airways is the easiest, fastest, and most exciting way to travel from Pago Pago (American Samoa) to Fagali'i (Samoa). Note that this route does NOT land at Faleolo International Airport, but rather, at the tiny Fagali'i airport, east of Apia. The flight was aboard a small, Viking DHC 6-300 Twin Otter plane with 18 seats. There were 7 passengers plus two crew on our flight and everyone was given a specific seat, so as to properly balance the aircraft. The take-off and landings were fast and exciting. This really felt like flying and made me want to learn to fly! It was a nice calm day, but there were still a few bumps along the way. The views out the window as we departed Pago Pago were great. Within 30 minutes we began our descent down to Upolu.
reviews.author: Keith-B-Robinson

reviews.title: Don't fly with Samoa Air
reviews.text: Don't fly with Samoa Air!!!!!! We were due to fly on the 4th of October. As we were about to leave for the airport and the phone rang to advise us that the flight was canceled. They offered another flight in 2 days time. Consequently to leave the next day we had to book with Virgin at last minute, full price purchases. I called the next day to ask for a letter stating that the flight was canceled and the reason why, and a refund. They said they would arrange this straight away. We arrive back from a lovely break but no refund, no letter. ONE MONTH on we are still waiting for a refund and simple email officially notifying of the cancellation and the reason why so we can do an insurance claim. We have continually contacted them and have been continually told that something will happen sooooon!
reviews.author: Andrew S

reviews.title: Flight delayed and no information about it!!!!
reviews.text: We have our flight at 7am, and check-in was supposed to start at 4am; till 5am it didn’t start. Then passport check was completely a mess, and suddenly they stop and told us our plane is being checked by the engineer because overnight was lightined during a storm. Samoa Airlines didn’t give us any info how long flight would be delayed or if it would be cancelled; 2 hours waiting without info!!!! Now it seems we’ll departure today, but still waiting at the airport (flight already delayed 3 hours and waiting). We have 2 more connections flights and it will be almost impossible to do it. Airline company not recommended at all!!
reviews.author: Samarsa_84

reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN
reviews.text: They have ONE PLANE and it goes back and forth every day so of course it will wear and tear easily! Our flight, along with hundreds of other people's flight, were delayed or cancelled because their ONE PLANE was under maintenance. Their call centre could only say "I'm not sure" when asked for a rough ETA of when it would be fixed. When asked to be put on another flight they said it would cost THE WHOLE FARE PLUS GST!!! They are rip offs! Next time I will be sure to fly ANY OTHER AIRLINE! As for Samoa airways.... NEVER AGAIN!!!
reviews.author: Tunes08

reviews.title: cancelled flight - rescheduling flight 8 hour before schedule return
reviews.text: Flying from SYD to APIA was ok. while returning the flight was cancelled (problem with aricraft) and they send us an email (by someone Briggette ) a day before which somehow got ignored as the sender was a name not airlines name. Cancelled flight was suppose to depart 1740 and replacement flight was scheduled earlier to 1030 hrs .....what ever you planned for day is out of window. we missed the 1030 flight unaware of change we were at airport at 1400 hrs expecting to board 1740 flight and were told there is no flight as it already gone at 1030. They started arranging a flight via Fiji (Nadi) to Sydney next day which was confirmed by 11 PM luckily . Meanwhile ask us to arrange accommodation for night with 3 kids 10,7 and 2 with 5 pieces of luggage, I am not sure what their fleet size is (no. of Aircrafts) but it seems they don't have backup and depend on other airlines which limit there options for replacement and rescheduling time of a flight. So there are more chances that you may have problems. Just imagine you flight is cancelled and you are asked to cut short you holidays by a day or more.....
reviews.author: narendra8isht

reviews.title: Great airlines very accommodating to wheelchair passengers!
reviews.text: From purchasing our tickets to check in and boarding Samoa airways is excellent. My husband is a wheelchair passenger and the airlines was so accommodating to us. I would recommend them to everyone even if you are not disabled.
reviews.author: Moana P

reviews.title: Comfortable Seats, Good Service
reviews.text: I flew Samoan Airlines for the first time last week. The flight was on time. The seats were large and comfortable. The food was ok. There was no entertainment but its only a 4 hour flight so not a big deal. Every aspect was satisfactory. However the best thing about flying Samoan Airlines is that you are supporting a small airline that brings competition to this route. This means competitive prices for consumers but they won't continue unless they are utilised! So please fly Samoan Airlines and support the little guy!!!
reviews.author: Brad M

reviews.title: Simple and Basic but ticks all boxes
reviews.text: We took advantage of an introductory fare with Samoa Airlines. Booking was easy, and contact with local staff was simple and the service was great. Our flight was on time, the on-board staff were helpful and very friendly, as are all Samoans we met. The plane was no full on our flight over or back so we had plenty of room to spread out. The only thing lacking is up to date entertainment. We had to use the on-board WiFi and tune in with our I-pad. Not that it worried us much as we did sleep a fair bit of the the flight. Meals were pretty much the standard for any economy flight. All in all we were happy with the flights and have no complaints.Thanks Samoa Airlines. We will definitely fly with Samoa Airlines next trip to Samoa.
reviews.author: WoollamiaTweety

reviews.title: Two thumbs up
reviews.text: I fly Samoa Airways regularly. I find the ground and air staff are friendly and attentive and, for a relatively new airline, very capable at their job. Pricing wise, Samoa Airways offers a reasonable and competitive service for the all inclusive package. Great job. See you again next time.
reviews.author: Kevin H

reviews.title: First time and I like!
reviews.text: I always flew with the same airline and I was more than happy to try out Samoa Airways. I was thrilled to realize that a cheaper ticket could still provide a comfortable flight with friendly service. I look forward to my next trip with Samoa Airways, fa'afetai lava
reviews.author: ksamoa685

reviews.title: New service airline to Samoa
reviews.text: We had a Trip A Deal to Samoa which included flying with Samoa Airlines. This is a budget airline but we had no real complaints. We did not like the food but others did. The bar service was pay only, understandably with a budget airline. The inside of the plane was a little worn and we had a problem with the seat belts, they worked but hard to do up. The hostesses were very friendly and we had no problems during the flight. The entertainment was a wifi connection to their site with games and movies on aeroplane mode on your ipad.
reviews.author: Colleen R

reviews.title: Excellent service and huge cost savings in fares
reviews.text: I usually fly Air New Zealand when I fly to Auckland and further. But this time I thought I would try Samoas newly formed airline Samoa airlines. Because of the low fares I was able to fly business class as the fare was actually half of the usual Air NZ business class fare. I was pleasantly surprised to find it was a really enjoyable experience. The seats were large and comfortable with ample leg room. The service by the stewardesses was excellent. The meal which was breakfast was freshly prepared, beautifully presented and delicious and serving size large by usual airline standards. I had a look at the instruction card for using wifi on board and was impressed by the clarity of instructions. The airline announcements both in Samoan and English were professional and well presented. It was nice to be served by local Samoans who understand Samoan etiquette. My only criticism of this experience was the luggage. Although our luggage had been tagged as "priority" we had to wait a while for them to arrive on the carousel in Auckland. I mention this so that the airline management can attend to this oversight. Otherwise, I definitely would recommend to fly Samoa airlines and visit Samoa.
reviews.author: Ioana C

reviews.title: Worst service EVER
reviews.text: Never using this airline ever again. Website is user friendly and doesn't understand that my email address is correct. The staff at maota samoa in Mangere who sorted out booking were the worst part. Not sure why they take bookings but their mannerism is disgustingly unprofessional & I think they should call Air NZ so they know how to service their customers. Never using Maota Samoa EVER & unfortunately won't be using samoa airways if we have to deal with Maota Samoa in Mangere, Auckland. If you want good service & people who understand your query then this airline isn't the one to go to. Thank you Samoan Consulate/Maota Samoa for proving once again that this airline will probably be made redundant like Virgin Blue!
reviews.author: Lii S

reviews.title: cheap flight.
reviews.text: We flew Sydney to Apia on a Thursday night flight on OL856. Its formally known as Polynesian Airways . The service was good as staff were friendly . There was stream line entertainment on the flight and the seats were comfortable with good leg room. This flight was pretty dreadful in regard its a "red eye " & basically you land at 6am feeling totally exhausted.
